report.title: Bathymetric survey and sedimentation analysis of Lago Patillas, Puerto Rico, August 2019

data_release.title: Spatial and bathymetric data for Lago Patillas, Puerto Rico, August 2019

verified_source_claims: The data release contains a stage-volume table calculated at 1.0-meter stage intervals from the 2019 terrain model.
The official vertical datum is Puerto Rico Vertical Datum of 2002 (PRVD02).
The spillway elevation is 67.55 meters above PRVD02.
The 2019 storage capacity at 67.55 meters above PRVD02 is 12.96 million cubic meters.
The PRVD02 datum supersedes the prior mean-sea-level datum for this reservoir.
limitations: The complete published stage-volume table bytes are not committed in v0.3.
The single spillway-capacity anchor is not sufficient for interpolation.
A real stage-to-storage transform remains prohibited until the complete table is acquired and hashed.
